description: This file contains the Turkish localization definitions for the Select2 jQuery plugin (version 4.0.6-rc.1). It defines translated strings for messages such as errors, prompts, and loading indicators used within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results fail to load.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message indicating that the user has entered too many characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to add more characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message when the maximum number of selections is reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while a search is in progress.
